blocks.text: Architectural Solution for a Barbershop Facade in Kyiv, Ukraine

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) developed an architectural solution for the reconstruction of a barbershop facade in Kyiv, Ukraine. The project required a careful balance between contemporary design, strong brand identity, and the architectural character of the surrounding urban environment.

The main objective was to transform the existing facade into a recognizable and visually distinctive commercial exterior while maintaining a refined and professional appearance appropriate for a premium barbershop.
Barbershop Facade Design
The architectural concept combines modern finishing materials, carefully selected colors, decorative elements, and exterior lighting.
Special attention was given to the entrance area, facade proportions, visual accents, and details that help emphasize the barbershop’s identity and improve its visibility from the street.
The result is a contemporary commercial facade designed to attract attention without appearing disconnected from the surrounding architecture.
Architecture for a Commercial Brand
For a commercial property, the facade is an important part of the customer experience and brand presentation.
The design was developed with several key factors in mind:
— recognizable architectural identity;
— visual connection with the barbershop brand;
— functional and clearly defined entrance area;
— modern finishing materials;
— decorative facade lighting;
— integration with the surrounding urban environment.
These elements create a distinctive exterior that supports the positioning of the barbershop as a modern premium men’s space.
3D Visualization of the Barbershop Facade
Photorealistic 3D architectural visualizations were created to demonstrate the proposed facade reconstruction before implementation.
The visualizations show the facade materials, colors, architectural details, lighting, entrance area, and overall appearance of the renovated building.
This makes it possible to evaluate the architectural concept and understand how the new commercial facade will look in its urban surroundings.
